candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement), advanced search filtered to Kosovo / financial-sector TA
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory publication venue for EU-funded external-action service contracts, including IPA technical assistance to Kosovo's Central Bank, Ministry of Finance and payment-system reform. Notices name the contracting authority, the TA lot, and often key-expert profiles (KE1 banking supervision, KE2 payments), which reveal both external expert hiring and the institutional reorganisations the TA supports. Contract-award notices name the winning consortium, which is the pointer to who will actually staff the assignment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED API / bulk notice downloads (ted.europa.eu APIs and daily packages) with CPV filters (66xxx financial services, 79xxx business services, 72xxx IT) and place-of-performance = Kosovo; fall back to advanced-search result HTML if API access is not provisioned.
queries_used: TED ted.europa.eu Kosovo technical assistance financial sector expert tender notice

candidates.why_relevant: Companion venue to TED for EU service contracts and grants; carries the terms of reference documents where key-expert job descriptions for Kosovo financial-sector TA are spelled out in detail.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a currently branded 'EU4Kosovo' financial-sector programme with published expert calls, in Albanian ('projekt ekspert konkurs punësimi').
negative_findings.result_summary: No EU4Kosovo financial-sector project page or expert call surfaced. The 'EU4...' naming convention was confirmed in the region (e.g. EU4PFM in Montenegro seeking junior/senior non-key experts), but no Kosovo financial-sector equivalent was found in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed query assumed a named programme that may not exist under that label for Kosovo; the collector should instead anchor on the EU Office in Kosovo (EEAS) and TED IPA notices rather than a programme brand.

negative_findings.description: Sought a current EBRD Kosovo bank-advisory / financial-institution consultant assignment notice.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo EBRD consultancy notices are demonstrably published on ECEPP (roads supervision, Gjilan wastewater PIU support), but no banking/payments advisory assignment appeared in general web results — ECEPP notices are poorly indexed by search engines.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this channel must be harvested from ECEPP directly on a schedule rather than via search engines; absence in search is not absence in the portal.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for donor/IFI financial-sector consultant notices relating to Kosovo returned essentially nothing Kosovo-specific.
negative_findings.result_summary: Terms 'oglas', 'konsultant', 'bankarski sektor', 'konkurs' pulled results from Serbia, Bosnia and Montenegro (EU4PFM, eufondovikonkursi.com) rather than Kosovo. Donor and IFI notices for Kosovo appear overwhelmingly in English and secondarily Albanian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring for this cell should be scoped narrowly (EEAS Kosovo _sr pages, e-Prokurimi Serbian versions, North-Kosovo institutions) rather than run as broad web search, or it will generate cross-border noise.

negative_findings.description: TED was searched for Kosovo financial-sector technical-assistance notices via general web search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only TED's own explanatory pages and one unrelated 2014 Kosovo education TA notice surfaced. TED notice bodies are not reliably reachable through general search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: TED must be collected via its API/bulk packages with CPV and place-of-performance filters; treating web search as the access path would systematically miss this cell's most authoritative channel.

negative_findings.description: Devex and DevelopmentAid carry the richest consolidated view of Kosovo-relevant donor consultant roles and tender history.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both gate detail behind subscriptions; only titles, organisations and partial metadata are publicly visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed if this cell is to be covered at depth; otherwise rely on primary portals and accept lag.

coverage_gaps.description: Several institutional URLs in this slice (IFC careers, KfW Kosovo country page, UNGM notice search, EU Funding & Tenders Portal) were inferred from institutional structure rather than reached from a confirmed Kosovo-specific hit in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Let the deterministic liveness pass resolve them; if a URL 404s, re-derive from the institution's site map rather than dropping the source.

coverage_gaps.description: IPA programming documents (IPA III Kosovo action documents, annual programmes) and the EU Office's contract-award lists were not examined; they describe planned TA lots months before any notice appears.

coverage_gaps.description: Implementing-consortium side not covered: firms that win Kosovo financial-sector TA (e.g. large EU TA contractors) advertise the key-expert posts on their own careers pages and on expert databases before mobilisation.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once award notices identify winning firms, add their careers pages plus expert-network platforms to the watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language donor/tender source specific to Kosovo financial-sector staffing was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Target the _sr variants of EEAS Kosovo pages and e-Prokurimi Serbian notices explicitly rather than broad sr web search; document if the channel is genuinely absent.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot notice pages at discovery time (HTML + PDF annexes) into the run archive; store stable IDs (displayNoticeId, TED notice number, WB OP number) for re-resolution.

brief: For Kosovo financial-sector staffing signals, the donor/IFI layer is dominated by four primary, high-credibility channels: TED (EU/IPA service contracts and key-expert ToRs), EBRD's ECEPP consultancy notices, World Bank project/procurement pages plus published procurement plans, and the EU Office in Kosovo as the originating contracting authority. None of these are reliably reachable through general web search — TED and ECEPP in particular are search-engine blind spots and must be harvested via API or scheduled portal crawls. The local-language layer is almost entirely Albanian (KosovaJob, PortalPune, SCAAK/IKAF, the CBK's own tenderët page and the national e-Prokurimi platform) and is where international assignments surface as concrete named hiring; Serbian-language coverage for this cell appears genuinely thin and should be scoped to EEAS _sr pages rather than broad search. Commercial aggregators (Devex, DevelopmentAid) offer the best consolidated view but are paywalled, making them a licensing decision rather than a free channel.
